market.icp: Privacy-conscious meeting participants who need local-first notes
market.buyerPain: A meeting goal entered before local transcript import is lost when the import creates a new meeting.
market.revenueHypothesis: Reliable, local-first note capture increases confidence in the free MVP before any paid offering is evaluated.

increment.name: transcript-import-meeting-goal
acceptanceCriteria: A non-empty meeting goal is copied into the started meeting note.
The meeting-goal input accepts no more than 280 characters.
The meeting-goal input explains that its value pre-fills the local note.
The meeting-goal input shows its current character count against the limit.
Markdown export preserves local owner notes before an available AI summary.
Meeting-library search finds terms in local owner notes.
Meeting-library search finds terms in local action-item text.
The local deterministic summary renders a non-empty meeting goal in a dedicated section.
The local deterministic summary omits the goal section when no goal exists.
The local deterministic summary does not repeat a dedicated meeting goal in its executive summary or key points.
The active note shows generated action items when they exist.
The active note omits the action-item panel when there are no action items.
Each displayed action includes its existing owner and due-date metadata.
Meeting-library search finds terms in local action-item owner and due-date metadata.
Each meeting-library card shows its local action-item count with correct singular/plural copy.
Deleting a local meeting requires explicit confirmation.
Cancelling the confirmation preserves the meeting record and active-note state.
A new local transcript import carries a non-empty meeting goal into its note.
A successful new local transcript import resets the title and meeting-goal setup fields.
Importing into an active meeting does not replace its owner notes with form values.
A blank meeting goal still starts with a blank note.

delivery.checker: separate local build and source-behavior assertions
delivery.rollback: Revert only the transcript-import meeting-goal helper and form reset.
delivery.stopCondition: Stop after one local verified increment; do not deploy, submit to an app store, or change licensing.
